Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to link a card that doesn't have ?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  Multiple effects that link a card can't be activated at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area.  Can I activate the [Main] effect on both copies of this card and link 1 [Appmon] trait Digimon card with the link cost reduced by a total of 4?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Main] By suspending this Tamer, you may link 1 [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon with the cost reduced by 2.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may app fuse into a Digimon card in the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
